role: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) für Daten- und KI-Plattformen
notes: Found by job-scout; German docs (posting requires German, B1 flagged as gap); gaps: Cloud Security/IAM/Governance, Kubernetes ops, Terraform; LLM Gateway Azure/AKS track to build; no deadline, no contact
apply_hint: Apply via the LinkedIn posting (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4481059896) or Markant's career page. Build first: the LLM Gateway Azure track (_work/project-brief-llm-gateway.md) is on the CV and not built yet.
verdict: Stretch application. Strong on the "Daten- und KI-Lösungen" side (you build exactly the workloads this platform hosts) and solid on containerised deployment (Docker, AWS CDK as Infrastructure as Code, GitLab CI/CD, an Azure-hosted app at Kniit). Weak on the core of a DevOps role: no hands-on Kubernetes operations beyond listing it in the Kniit stack, no Terraform/Bicep, nothing on Cloud Security, IAM or governance, and the posting asks for sufficient German.

form_fields.label: Warum Markant?
form_fields.value: Markant sits between ~15,000 suppliers and ~200 retailers and processes invoices, master data and payments centrally; a data and AI platform for that must be secure and reliable, and AI is already in products like m.ProductWizard. I want to build that platform with the people who use it.

form_fields.label: Gehaltsvorstellung
form_fields.value: €70,000 gross/year (range €60,000–75,000). Must clear the EU Blue Card threshold.

form_fields.label: Standort
form_fields.value: will relocate to Offenburg; mobile work welcome.

questions.q: Wie würden Sie einen containerisierten KI-Service auf Kubernetes betreiben?
questions.a: Be honest that Kubernetes ops is new from your side (only in the Kniit stack). Walk through the LLM Gateway once built: Helm chart, probes, requests/limits, HPA, rolling updates, rollback with helm rollback, logs in Log Analytics.

questions.q: Wie setzen Sie Infrastructure as Code und CI/CD ein?
questions.a: Covestro: AWS CDK for the agentic app and for the thesis evaluation infrastructure (Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB), GitLab CI/CD. Then Terraform from the gateway project (plan on PR, apply on main, OIDC login, no stored secrets).

questions.q: Was verstehen Sie unter Cloud Security, IAM und Governance auf Azure?
questions.a: Managed identities / workload identity instead of keys, Key Vault, least-privilege RBAC on resource-group scope, Azure Policy for allowed locations and required tags, tagging for cost (FinOps). Say clearly what you have built yourself (the project) vs. read about.
